svg.title: Midpoint weighted moments estimate mean and population variance from grouped data
svg.desc: The three height classes are represented by midpoints two, six and twelve centimetres, with frequencies four, twelve and sixteen. Weighted midpoint values are eight, seventy-two and one hundred ninety-two, summing to two hundred seventy-two. Squared-midpoint weighted values are sixteen, four hundred thirty-two and two thousand three hundred four, summing to two thousand seven hundred fifty-two. Dividing by total frequency thirty-two gives estimated mean eight point five centimetres, population variance fifty-five quarters square centimetres and standard deviation square root fifty-five over two centimetres. These estimates replace unknown within-class measurements by midpoints.
